maya.sre: FYI: US-WEST maintenance window Sun 01:00-03:00 UTC. Planned activities: edge router kernel patch, controlled BGP flap, KV prefix refresh, and a short autoscaler soak. Goal: validate rollback and routing policies; expect small p99 blips.

linus: What's the SLO temporary band?

maya.sre: Temporarily relax inference.p99_ms to 140% for affected routes. Fallback order: local->adjacent->hosted-fallback. Only 'tier:best-effort' routes and opt-ins will fallback. Dedicated pools excluded.

tamara: Oncall: I'm primary, Oliver backup. If p99 > 2x for 10m, escalate. I'll post 15m updates during the window.

oncall-bot: Maintenance created. Pager override active 2026-04-12T01:00:00Z-2026-04-12T03:00:00Z.

dave: Will the KV warmup run automatically?

maya.sre: Yes - warmup queued at T-90m; you can trigger manually with tools/cache_warm.py --region=us-west --parallel=6 --qps=150. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/us-west-maint.

oliver: I'll mute deploy-bot for the window.

maya.sre: Thanks everyone 1 Keep chatter to incidents channel during the window. Closing thread.
